entries.title: I Chronicles 8:1
segments: ¶And Benjamin was the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:2
segments: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:3
segments: And Bela had sons, Addar and Gera, the father of Ehud,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:4
segments: And Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:5
segments: And Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:6
segments: And these are the sons of Ehud, heads of families of those living in Geba: Iglaam and Alemeth

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:7
segments: And Naaman and Ahijah and Gera; and Iglaam was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:8
segments: And Shaharaim became the father of children in the country of the Moabites after driving out Hushim and Beerah his wives;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:9
segments: And by Hodesh his wife he became the father of Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:10
segments: And Jeuz and Shachia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:11
segments: And Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:12
segments: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed (he was the builder of Ono and Lod and their daughter-towns);

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:13
segments: And Beriah and Shema, who were heads of the families of those who were living in Aijalon, who put to flight the people living in Gath;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:14
segments: And their brothers Shashak and Jeremoth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:15
segments: And Zebadiah and Arad and Eder

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:16
segments: And Michael and Ishpah and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:17
segments: And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:18
segments: And Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:19
segments: And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:20
segments: And Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:21
segments: And Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:22
segments: And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:23
segments: And Abdon and Zichri and Hanan

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:24
segments: And Hananiah and Elam and Anathothijah

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:25
segments: And Iphdeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:26
segments: And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:27
segments: And Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri, the sons of Jeremoth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:28
segments: These were heads of families in their generations; chief men: these were living in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:29
segments: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:30
segments: And his oldest son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:31
segments: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:32
segments: And Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. And they were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:33
segments: ¶And Ner was the father of Abner, and Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:34
segments: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:35
segments: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:36
segments: And Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:37
segments: And Moza was the father of Binea: Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:38
segments: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:39
segments: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his oldest son, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:40
segments: And the sons of Ulam were men of war, bowmen, and had a great number of sons and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were the sons of Benjamin.
